name: toolbox-find-and-run
about: Build tools on with two tools in the global toolbox: the system prompt carries the toolbox guide line and the frozen index (one tool untested), find_tool is offered. The model looks two jobs up in one parallel batch (one fits, one fits no tool), then runs the tool it found by name through run_shell in the sandbox, and answers.

csv-profile.TOOL.md:
---
name: csv-profile
summary: Column names and row count of a CSV file
use_when: you get a new CSV file
usage: csv-profile FILE
examples:
  - csv-profile data.csv
tags: [csv, stats]
author: qwen
status: tested
created: 2026-07-08
---

Prints the header line and the number of data rows.
